Guggenheim reiterates Alphabet as buy Guggenheim raised its price target on the stock to $375 per share from $330. "We expect WeRide to ramp up its fleet size and turn profitable in 2029, driven by (1) a broader overseas rollout of robotaxi services, supported by partnerships and first-mover advantages; (2) improving profitability of robotaxi in China market, thanks to better economies of scale; (3) ramp up of robobuses, robovans and robosweepers business, leveraging the WeRide One platform." Goldman Sachs upgrades Chime Financial to buy from neutral Goldman said investors should buy the dip in the financial services company.
attributes.result.structuredContent.results.2.title: A ‘tale of two markets’ in private credit emerges as fundamentals diverge – S&P - PitchBook
attributes.result.structuredContent.results.2.conte: ## The downgrade-to-upgrade ratio of borrowers with credit estimates has jumped to 1.8x, the highest since Q2 2024. Many of the strongest private credit borrowers have continued to improve their fundamentals, according to S&P Global Ratings, though pockets of weakness and a growing gap between the best and worst borrowers tell a more nuanced “tale of two markets.” Credit estimates are indications of a likely credit rating on an unrated entity, which S&P provides for some private credit borrowers whose loans are held in CLOs. The downgrade-to-upgrade ratio among borrowers with a credit estimate from the agency jumped to 1.8x, the highest ratio since Q2 2024, according to a Nov. 20 report from S&P.
